meta.title: Reopening a saved draft restores every field
gaps: Compare each restored sheet cell with its originally entered value; fill_sheet does not expose its values and the catalog has no sheet-value snapshot assertion.
Compare the exact selected template, line-item identities, committed schedule and participant identities against their original values when the setup steps use executor-selected defaults.
Compare the restored title against an independently captured original input value; expect_api_value checks the saved API title rather than a pre-save input snapshot.
